annual.note: Balance sheet, flows, shares and awards all from the FY2025 10-K. Cover-page shares 107,790,732 at 2026-01-31 not used; balance-sheet count used. No bank borrowings, no convertible notes (Note 12), no finance leases. debtCurrent/debtNoncurrent hold only the EDA tools software licenses liability (installment obligation with imputed interest, financing-classified payments; the reviewed package treats it as a separate capital claim, 31.4M nominal remaining at 2026-06-30). If a consumer wants conventional borrowings only, debt = 0. Options are all vested and exercisable (88,900). Nonvested 2.88M includes performance units at the number the filing reports; performance units can pay 0-200% of target.
